final_message:
The fix is complete. The `wrap` function had a bug where when a single word exceeded the width, it would incorrectly start a new line with an empty string (`''`). 

The original code checked if `len(cur) + extra > width` before deciding whether to start a new line, but this didn't account for the case when `cur` is empty and `w` alone exceeds `width`.

The fix removes the special case that was causing the empty line - now single words are simply placed on their own line without creating an empty string. All 5 tests pass.
